title: Build the DFT, the FFT, and four windows
brief: Build the DFT as a matrix and as a recursive radix-2 FFT, compute bin frequencies, build the classic windows, and measure each window's leakage.
hints: np.outer(k, k) with k = np.arange(n) gives every product k * m at once.
In fft_radix2, combine the halves with np.concatenate([E + T, E - T]), where T is the twiddles times the odd half.
n & (n - 1) is 0 exactly when a positive integer n is a power of two.
A periodic window divides by n, a symmetric one by n - 1. scipy calls the rectangular window boxcar.
In leakage, normalize by the value at index 0 before taking decibels, so the main lobe peaks at 0 dB.
